category_summary: **Release:** **Hermes Agent v0.22.0** — the **[Threshold Release](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-79767b16890e)** — owned the week. **@Teknium**'s [primary announcement](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-0722b0daa4d3) (880 likes / 141k views) detailed a streamlined no-provider-setup onboarding and one-click **Connectors**; **@NousResearch**'s flagship post confirmed the release name and drew the batch's biggest engagement, while a ['give it a try' CTA](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-cc3f035f1edc) and the [full release-notes link](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-6e930e16f517) rounded out launch day. Even a lone [🤗](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-2b47428a3d1a) from **Teknium** pulled 155 likes — sentiment is celebratory and unusually warm. **Philosophy:** **Teknium** [says](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-997ba2259648) this version's focus was making it 'simpler, easier, and more magical' to get into **Hermes Agent**. **Guidance:** the **[msix](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-56c2366889cd)** package is only needed for the Microsoft Store path — normal update/install flows are unchanged. **Ecosystem:** an [open invitation to submit **plugins**](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-221916c891a7) and [praise for a community **Home Assistant** integration](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-be37592e680f) highlight an active builder base Nous wants to grow. **Technical notes:** [cloud browser services (**browser-use**, **browserbase**) get blocked](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-7fd0407d831e) for captcha-breaking behavior; [free search does not use self-hosted **Firecrawl**](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-58fff36cc074); [the desktop app's direction just shifted](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-b10c34a45ca1) after user friction; and a [candid aside](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-e66d2f767f7a) revealed the recent refactor produced the most expensive single agent session anyone at Nous has ever run. **Beyond the release:** **Teknium**'s [high-reach take](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-6242ac6aa791) that AI is reshaping games-industry business models (554 likes) pairs with [stated intent to empower the large indie game dev community](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-5a22ad52e00d), and **@rlaope**'s [well-performing switch from **OpenRouter**](/?date=2026-10-15&category=social#item-d1aea4fb9c8d) to a provider serving **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash** at ~800 tok/s reflects community appetite for ultrafast inference. Overall: a major, well-received release with visibly hands-on developer responsiveness.
category_summary_html: Release: Hermes Agent v0.22.0 — the Threshold Release — owned the week. @Teknium's primary announcement (880 likes / 141k views) detailed a streamlined no-provider-setup onboarding and one-click Connectors; @NousResearch's flagship post confirmed the release name and drew the batch's biggest engagement, while a 'give it a try' CTA and the full release-notes link rounded out launch day. Even a lone 🤗 from Teknium pulled 155 likes — sentiment is celebratory and unusually warm. Philosophy: Teknium says this version's focus was making it 'simpler, easier, and more magical' to get into Hermes Agent. Guidance: the msix package is only needed for the Microsoft Store path — normal update/install flows are unchanged. Ecosystem: an open invitation to submit plugins and praise for a community Home Assistant integration highlight an active builder base Nous wants to grow. Technical notes: cloud browser services (browser-use, browserbase) get blocked for captcha-breaking behavior; free search does not use self-hosted Firecrawl; the desktop app's direction just shifted after user friction; and a candid aside revealed the recent refactor produced the most expensive single agent session anyone at Nous has ever run. Beyond the release: Teknium's high-reach take that AI is reshaping games-industry business models (554 likes) pairs with stated intent to empower the large indie game dev community, and @rlaope's well-performing switch from OpenRouter to a provider serving DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at ~800 tok/s reflects community appetite for ultrafast inference. Overall: a major, well-received release with visibly hands-on developer responsiveness.

items.content:
Hermes Agent v0.22.0 is now live!

The highlights:

A much smoother easier to use onboarding - you don't even need to hook up a provider to get started - just install and start working!

Connectors - much easier to connect with any app, just click install and login - and done.

Stable Channel for Hermes Update - no more update anxiety and get releases that are tested much more thoroughly than a random commit, or switch back to main channel if you want the bleeding edge.

Over 2,500 people contributed to this version, thank you all!

See the full changelog here, it's our biggest version over version change ever:

https://t.co/rOPwklptGI
